headline: US Factory Orders Rise 1.8% in September Following Upward Revision
summary: US factory orders increased 1.8% in September compared to August, while August orders were revised upward to a 0.3% gain from July.
why: Factory orders are a key macroeconomic indicator reflecting the health of the manufacturing sector and overall industrial demand in the United States.

impacts.name: United States
impacts.why: Stronger manufacturing orders indicate broader economic expansion.
